descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S04 Real devices, local stack only: dictation, a dropped connection mid-dictation, and a phone with the wrong date or time zone, both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Dictated and typed input both save reliably and both produce a usable summary; Save Note reliably commits the note. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 3; TFA-92588 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U4 The stored dictation is identical on reopen: Save Note never rewrites, summarizes or renames the physician's text (issue #39), tested with unusual phrasing. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • U11 Save Note timing: panels within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10 cycles (a target, not pass/fail; a run over 30 s not caused by the AI service is investigated). … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9)
  • U12 Time rules that Save Note touches ('today' on the course line, today's vitals/labs column, the 12 h window) use the server clock; … (UAT 3.8)
  • T5 The pre-round flow and its summary-failed state work on web, iOS and Android. (TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • T7 A voice failure in the pre-round notes or Important Points channel loses nothing: a live recording is kept until its transcript is in the field (PR #95); … (TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 comment 2026-10-05)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Local stack only. Android: the debug APK of e02167f bundled for the local stack, as scripts/android-lane.ts builds it (adb reverse tcp:4510 and tcp:4511), on the rc_api36 emulator or a cabled phone. iOS: an Xcode debug build pointed at the local Convex URL. Desktop: Chrome with a microphone on http://localhost:6473. …

When (1) Tap Dictate, read the S01 text (Hospital) and the S02 text (Nursing Home) aloud, stop, review, Save Note; close and reopen the editor. (2) Start dictating in the pre-round box, turn Wi-Fi off mid-sentence, turn it back on, tap Recover if offered, in both modes and in the Important Points channel. …

Then (1) The reviewed transcript is what is stored and shown on reopen; the panels fill as in S01/S02; the run records the speech-to-text engine (GPT-Live) and the pre-round model. (2) The words spoken before and after the drop land in the box they were dictated into; nothing is lost; an error shows only if the one whisper-1 recovery fails (T7). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human check against U3/U4 (reopened text equals the reviewed transcript word for word), T7 (nothing spoken is lost), 3.8 (same day label and date as the correct device; code read predicts a Fail, see S22; the day roll is known: TFA-92584); engine and model written in the run notes (3.9). The web half of the clock check is automated in S22

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S04

Real devices, local stack only: dictation, a dropped connection mid-dictation, and a phone with the wrong date or time zone, both modes

Tickets: TFA-92588 Pre-Rounding Summary (ready for pr); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status blocked in newspec-c/results.json → blocked (blocked).

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Part (3) done as a record (gate TFA-92588 ready for pr = todo): Save Note on one Hospital patient from the phone 2 days ahead, from the phone in Pacific/Honolulu and from the correct desktop (typed text; summary answered at the socket). The phone 2 days ahead wrote its course line as 'Oct 15' (server-corrected) but shows 'Saved 3:02 AM · Oct 17'; the Honolulu phone wrote 'Oct 14' (its local day) and 'Saved 8:02 AM · Oct 14'; the desktop's 'Oct 15' line replaced the first one, so the chart ends with two lines dated Oct 15 and Oct 14 for the same morning. No date is shown with the vitals panel. Left: parts (1) and (2) need a real voice into real phones and the live transcription session (and Wi-Fi drops mid-dictation).

Evidence: 5 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android; dictation by microphone/speaker (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Real dictation by microphone, Wi-Fi drops on Android / iOS phones and phones with a wrong clock: microphone/speaker, iOS and Android are set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
